propose_guide: BEST WHEN: NL wants prediction-market sentiment on Fed/politics/events. ALWAYS label as sentiment_only. For institutional Fed odds use fedwatch/probabilities instead. Set query (e.g. fed rate) or event_slug. Output language-neutral; compose follows workflow/Staff language.
